title: Chapter 285: What Happens to You After You Die?
html:
“Now is not the time to speculate who the killer is. That is the police’s job.” The nurse sighed. “I’m more worried about Jiang Ling’s therapy.”

“I’ll handle it, but you’ll have to give me some time.” Chen Ge now understood the outline of the case, but the nurse’s account contained several inconsistencies that demanded closer investigation.

“You’ll handle it? You’ll bring Fan Yu away with you?”

“I mean I’ll cure Jiang Ling.” Chen Ge knew Fan Yu better than anyone there, and he knew the boy had not lied.

The nurse was baffled. “How are you going to cure her? You’re not a doctor.”

“It costs you nothing to let me try.” Ignoring the nurse’s bafflement, Chen Ge returned to the bedroom. He had extensive experience dealing with Baleful Specters and knew how to earn their goodwill.

Their parents’ deaths must be the source of Jiang Ling’s and her sister’s anguish. If I find the murderer and bring them to justice, I should earn the sisters’ trust.

Judging from Fan Yu’s drawing, Jiang Ling’s sister was far from weak; she might even be a Red Specter. If Chen Ge could befriend her—or better yet, persuade her to join the Haunted House—he would have far less to fear while Zhang Ya remained dormant.

Chen Ge tried to communicate with Jiang Ling, but the little girl ignored him other than occasionally using a fearful gaze to look at him.

“What do you want to know? I’ll ask.” Fan Yu walked to the girl and pointed at Chen Ge. “He’s a good guy; he can also see your big sister.”

“Really?” The little girl looked innocently at Chen Ge, who nodded at once. Seizing the opportunity, he asked her several questions and promised to help find her sister. Delighted, Jiang Ling presented him with the crushed spider, explaining that it resembled her sister.

Chen Ge accepted the child’s gift without complaint. He carefully slipped the spider’s body into a plastic bottle and put it away. Once he had gained her trust, he tried to learn more.

The more he asked, however, the less he understood. Perhaps because of her age, Jiang Ling remembered little, and most of her answers made no sense. In the end, Chen Ge obtained only her former address and her sister’s name—Zhu Xingrou.

The nurse escorted Chen Ge from the Children’s Home at nine. After returning to New Century Park, he packed his hammer and Xiaoxiao into his backpack. He intended to investigate Jiang Ling’s former home that very night.

I should bring this too. It may prove useful.He added the bottle containing the spider, then hired a taxi to Lin Guan Village on the outskirts of Western Jiujiang.

During the ride, Chen Ge called Inspector Lee in hopes of learning more about the case, but the officer’s phone was switched off.

Is he on a mission?Chen Ge looked at his watch. Being a cop these days is not easy.

Chen Ge reached Lin Guan Village at around 11:30 p.m. The isolated settlement nestled deep in the mountains, accessible by roads repaired only a few years earlier. A cold wind swept down the slopes. Not a single light shone despite the relatively early hour; either the villagers slept unusually early, or the place was deserted.

There’s not even a streetlight or a convenience store; how am I supposed to ask for directions? The place the girl mentioned should be further inside the mountain, but it will be easy for me to get lost if I wander into the mountain alone.Chen Ge realized how complicated things were when he arrived at the destination. He walked into the village using the recently repaired asphalt road.

After only ten meters, the asphalt gave way to mud. From a distance the village had appeared new, but within, it was old and dilapidated. Many buildings had stood for decades.

Something is not right. Why does this village feel so creepy?Chen Ge stopped moving. He opened the zipper on his backpack to reveal the head of Doctor Skull-cracker’s hammer.

Most of the doors are covered with dust. This village should have plenty of empty houses, and the number of villagers still living here should be very small.

He wandered to a random home, and when he got near, he realized the door was locked from the outside. If someone was in, the lock would definitely be on the inside. What has happened to this village?

He slowly backed away. Just as he decided to leave the village, both phones in his pocket vibrated at once.

What happened?Chen Ge checked the black phone first. A message announced that the Third Sick Hall Trial Mission’s completion rate had risen to eighty-seven percent. It seems another patient has been captured.

Chen Ge opened his own phone. It was a call from Inspector Lee. “Uncle San Bao, I thought you’d blocked me. That saddened me.”

“We had an operation tonight, and everyone involved had to switch off their phones.” Though Inspector Lee sounded exhausted, satisfaction colored his voice. “Good news: we captured Patient 8 from the Third Sick Hall.”

“Xiong Qing has been captured?!”

“You should be glad. The man has been seen patrolling around New Century Park for the past few days; he was probably targeting you.”

“Where is he? Can I talk to him?”

“He’s in intensive care. The madman attacked several officers, and the team from headquarters had to shoot him in the legs and shoulders before they could restrain him. He’s currently unconscious.”

“Inspector Lee, capturing the murderer is a good thing, but you have to be careful. After all, safety first.”

“Stop circling the point. What do you want?” Inspector Lee knew Chen Ge well enough to recognize that sudden concern always preceded a request.

“Then I’ll come right out with it. About six months ago, there was a poisoning case at Western Jiujiang’s Lin Guan Village; do you have any recollection of it?” Chen Ge asked directly.

“I do, but that is not within our jurisdiction.”

“But it’s in Western Jiujiang!” The answer caught Chen Ge off guard.

“Lin Guan Village falls under the mountain district.” Inspector Lee sighed. “Listen to me. Don’t launch one of your reckless investigations. Strange things have happened in that village before. The poisoning was a major case, and Captain Yan’s team handled it.”

“What weird things?”

“That will be confidential information.”

“Then can you tell me about the poison case six months ago? Fan Yu is staying at the same Children’s Home with the only survivor, a little girl. I’m doing this to help them.”

“A little girl…” Inspector Lee paused, and his tone suddenly turned serious. “Chen Ge, you’d better keep a safe distance from that girl.”

“I admit she’s a bit weird, but there’s no need to avoid her.”

“According to the investigation, the final suspect and the one who had the power to commit the murders was the little girl.”

After a brief pause, Inspector Lee added, “She once said something very curious.”
